recognize_zh: 這個視野以紅血球為主，箭頭指著一顆明顯比旁邊淋巴球大的異常細胞，核大、染色質細緻、胞質中等藍色；單看這一顆只能說是非典型大淋巴樣細胞，需要配合其他視野才能支持 DLBCL 侵犯。
features: Single large atypical mononuclear cell (arrow) with high N:C ratio
Large round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely granular chromatin
Moderate rim of pale to medium blue agranular cytoplasm
Field is predominantly red cells with a normal-appearing lymphocyte/monocytoid cell at top right for size comparison
Hematopoietic precursors are scarce in this field, limiting assessment of marrow involvement
describe_en: Smear from the stated bone marrow aspirate shows a blood-rich field with only rare nucleated cells, including a large atypical mononuclear cell (arrow) with a high N:C ratio, finely granular chromatin and a moderate rim of agranular blue cytoplasm. A smaller mononuclear cell at the upper right provides size comparison. Hematopoietic precursors are sparse, so this field is hemodiluted and resembles peripheral blood. A single atypical large cell is suggestive of but not diagnostic for involvement by large B-cell lymphoma; evaluation of cellular particles, flow cytometry and core biopsy are required.

ddx.vs: A single large cell cannot be separated from a blast by morphology alone; CD34/TdT versus CD19/CD20 with light chain restriction on flow cytometry resolves it.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocyte or large granular lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, and LGLs have azurophilic granules, both absent in this cell.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and promyelocytes contain abundant azurophilic granules.
